name: cs2mv-steam-gc-helper
description: Turns a CS2 share code into a demo URL by asking the game coordinator. Owns its own Steam credentials so that cs2mv never has to.
//overrides: steam-user pulls two dependencies with published advisories: adm-zip
<0.6.0 (zip decompression bomb) and, via steam-appticket, protobufjs 6.x
(prototype pollution and code execution through crafted descriptors).
`npm audit fix --force` resolves them by DOWNGRADING steam-user to 3.15,
which predates the refresh-token login this helper relies on - that is a
worse position, not a better one. Pinning the transitive versions forward
keeps steam-user 5.x and drops the advisories. Both are API compatible for
the way steam-user uses them; the tests below cover the paths this helper
